description: Validation requirements enforced before and after the FORGE Governance Synchronizer updates experimental shadow governance documents.

preWriteChecks.description: Repository state must be captured before synchronization.
A structured session snapshot must exist.
The session snapshot must satisfy its schema.
Every target file must be inside docs/architecture/synchronized.
Every requested section update must be explicitly permitted by editable-sections.json.
Every requested operation must be explicitly granted by capabilities.json.
Work may be marked complete only when repository and validation evidence support completion.

postWriteChecks.description: Authoritative FORGE governance documents must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Human-controlled shadow sections must remain unchanged.
All synchronization section markers must be present, unique, and correctly paired.
Active phase information must agree across applicable shadow documents.
Current objective information must agree across applicable shadow documents.
Recorded HEAD, origin/main, working-tree state, tests, and build results must match captured evidence.
Every factual claim introduced by synchronization must be traceable to captured evidence.
Every shadow document must identify itself as experimental and non-authoritative.

rules: Warnings may not override required failures.
Validation failures must identify the failed rule and supporting evidence.
A failed synchronization must not leave partially updated files.
The synchronizer must restore original shadow content if post-write validation fails.
The synchronizer must never repair a failure by modifying authoritative governance documents.
Owner approval is required before any validation rule may be weakened, removed, or made optional.
